name: @mantleio/mantle-mcp

tools.name: mantle_getChainInfo
tools.description: Return static chain configuration for mainnet or sepolia (Mantle native gas token is MNT). Examples: mainnet chain_id=5000 with WMNT=0x78c1b0C915c4FAA5FffA6CAbf0219DA63d7f4cb8; sepolia chain_id=5003 with WMNT=0x19f5557E23e9914A18239990f6C70D68FDF0deD5.

tools.name: mantle_getChainStatus
tools.description: Return live block height and gas price from Mantle RPC. Examples: mainnet block_number=12345678 and gas_price_gwei="0.02"; sepolia health check before running token workflows.

tools.name: mantle_getTransactionReceipt
tools.description:
Fetch on-chain transaction receipt by hash: status (success/reverted), gas used, fee in MNT, value transferred, from/to addresses, and log count. Use this to verify transaction results — NEVER manually call eth_getTransactionReceipt or parse raw RPC responses.

Examples:
- Check swap result: hash='0x...'
- Verify transfer: hash='0x...'

tools.name: mantle_estimateGas
tools.description:
Estimate gas cost for an unsigned transaction. Pass the to/data/value fields from any unsigned_tx object. Provide 'from' (sender address) for reliable estimates on DeFi transactions that depend on msg.sender.

Examples:
- Estimate swap cost: pass to, data, value, and from (sender wallet) from the unsigned_tx JSON output

from.description: Sender wallet address. Recommended for accurate estimates on swaps, Aave, and LP operations.

tools.name: mantle_resolveAddress
tools.description: Resolve trusted contract addresses by key, alias, or label from the Mantle registry. Examples: identifier='USDC' -> 0x09Bc4E0D864854c6aFB6eB9A9cdF58aC190D0dF9; identifier='Agni Router' -> 0x319B69888b0d11cEC22caA5034e25FfFBDc88421.

environment.description: Legacy alias for network (`testnet` maps to `sepolia`).

tools.name: mantle_validateAddress
tools.description: Validate address format/checksum and optional bytecode presence. Examples: 0x78c1b0C915c4FAA5FffA6CAbf0219DA63d7f4cb8 (WMNT) and 0x319B69888b0d11cEC22caA5034e25FfFBDc88421 (Agni Router).

tools.name: mantle_getNonce
tools.description: Get the current pending nonce (transaction count) for an address. Use this when the user reports nonce errors during signing/broadcast, then pass the returned nonce value (including 0 for fresh accounts) to build tools via the nonce parameter. Use the returned nonce immediately — it reflects the mempool state at collected_at_utc and may become stale within seconds if other transactions are pending.

address.description: Wallet address to query nonce for.

tools.name: mantle_getBalance
tools.description: Get native MNT balance for an address. Examples: address=0x458F293454fE0d67EC0655f3672301301DD51422 -> balance_mnt='1.5' before contract operations.

tools.name: mantle_getTokenBalances
tools.description: Batch read ERC-20 token balances for an address. Examples: tokens=['USDC','WETH'] -> 0x09Bc4E0D864854c6aFB6eB9A9cdF58aC190D0dF9 and 0xdEAddEaDdeadDEadDEADDEAddEADDEAddead1111.

tools.name: mantle_getAllowances
tools.description: Batch read ERC-20 allowances for token/spender pairs. Examples: pair {token:'USDC', spender:'0x319B69888b0d11cEC22caA5034e25FfFBDc88421'} for Agni Router.

tools.name: mantle_getTokenInfo
tools.description: Read ERC-20 token metadata (name, symbol, decimals, total supply). Examples: token='USDC' -> 0x09Bc4E0D864854c6aFB6eB9A9cdF58aC190D0dF9, token='WETH' -> 0xdEAddEaDdeadDEadDEADDEAddEADDEAddead1111.

tools.name: mantle_getTokenPrices
tools.description: Read token prices for valuation workflows; returns null when no trusted source exists. Examples: tokens=['USDC','WMNT'] on mainnet (0x09Bc4E0D864854c6aFB6eB9A9cdF58aC190D0dF9, 0x78c1b0C915c4FAA5FffA6CAbf0219DA63d7f4cb8).

tools.name: mantle_resolveToken
tools.description: Resolve token symbol using quick reference plus canonical token-list cross-check. Examples: symbol='USDC' -> 0x09Bc4E0D864854c6aFB6eB9A9cdF58aC190D0dF9, symbol='mETH' -> 0xcDA86A272531e8640cD7F1a92c01839911B90bb0.

tools.name: mantle_getSwapQuote
tools.description: Read swap quotes across all Mantle DEXes. IMPORTANT: Always use provider='best' (default) to compare quotes from Agni, Merchant Moe, and Fluxion — only specify a single provider if the user explicitly requests a specific DEX. Examples: WMNT 0x78c1b0C915c4FAA5FffA6CAbf0219DA63d7f4cb8 to USDC 0x09Bc4E0D864854c6aFB6eB9A9cdF58aC190D0dF9.

provider.description: Routing provider. Defaults to 'best' which compares all DEXes and picks the best rate. Only specify a single provider (agni/fluxion/merchant_moe) if the user explicitly requests a specific DEX.

tools.name: mantle_getPoolLiquidity
tools.description: Read pool reserves and liquidity metadata. Examples: inspect a Mantle DEX pool for USDC 0x09Bc4E0D864854c6aFB6eB9A9cdF58aC190D0dF9 / USDT0 0x779Ded0c9e1022225f8E0630b35a9b54bE713736 liquidity.

tools.name: mantle_getPoolOpportunities
tools.description: Scan and rank candidate pools for a token pair on Mantle DEXes. Examples: token_a='MNT' (native mapped to WMNT 0x78c1b0C915c4FAA5FffA6CAbf0219DA63d7f4cb8), token_b='mETH' 0xcDA86A272531e8640cD7F1a92c01839911B90bb0.

tools.name: mantle_getProtocolTvl
tools.description: Read protocol-level TVL for Mantle DeFi protocols using layered sources. Examples: protocol=agni for Agni Finance TVL, protocol=merchant_moe for Merchant Moe TVL, protocol=all for combined view.

tools.name: mantle_getLendingMarkets
tools.description:
Read Aave V3 lending market metrics on Mantle, including Isolation Mode data.

Each market includes: supply/borrow APY, TVL, LTV, liquidation threshold, isolation_mode (bool), debt_ceiling_usd, borrowable_in_isolation (bool), borrowing_enabled.

Isolation Mode assets (WETH, WMNT): supplying them as your ONLY collateral restricts borrows to assets with borrowable_in_isolation=true (USDC, USDT0, USDe, GHO).

Examples:
- All markets: protocol='aave_v3'
- Single market: protocol='aave_v3', asset='USDC'

tools.name: mantle_getV3PoolState
tools.description:
Read on-chain state of a Uniswap V3-compatible pool (Agni Finance or Fluxion) on Mantle. Returns sqrtPriceX96, current tick, tick spacing, liquidity, and human-readable prices.

Resolve by pool_address directly, or by (token_a + token_b + fee_tier + provider) to look up via the factory.

Examples:
- By address: pool_address='<pool_address>'
- By pair: token_a='WMNT', token_b='USDC', fee_tier=3000, provider='agni'

pool_address.description: V3 pool contract address. If provided, token_a/token_b/fee_tier/provider are optional.

token_a.description: First token symbol or address. Required if pool_address is not given.

token_b.description: Second token symbol or address. Required if pool_address is not given.

fee_tier.description: V3 fee tier in hundredths of a bip (500=0.05%, 3000=0.3%, 10000=1%). Required if pool_address is not given.

provider.description: DEX provider: 'agni' or 'fluxion'. Required if pool_address is not given; optional hint when pool_address is given.

tools.name: mantle_getLBPairState
tools.description:
Read on-chain state of a Merchant Moe Liquidity Book pair on Mantle. Returns active bin ID, bin step, token metadata, active bin reserves, and reserves for +-5 nearby bins.

Resolve by pair_address directly, or by (token_a + token_b + bin_step) to look up via the LB Factory.

Examples:
- By address: pair_address='<pair_address>'
- By pair: token_a='WMNT', token_b='USDC', bin_step=25

pair_address.description: LB pair contract address. If provided, token_a/token_b/bin_step are optional.

token_a.description: First token symbol or address. Required if pair_address is not given.

token_b.description: Second token symbol or address. Required if pair_address is not given.

bin_step.description: LB bin step (e.g. 1, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25). Required if pair_address is not given.

tools.name: mantle_getV3Positions
tools.description:
List Uniswap V3-compatible LP positions (Agni Finance or Fluxion) owned by an address on Mantle. For each position returns token_id, both tokens with metadata, fee tier, tick bounds, liquidity, uncollected fees (tokens_owed0/1), and whether the current price is in range.

Falls back to Transfer event log scanning when the position manager does not implement ERC721Enumerable (Agni). Partial scan failures are surfaced via the optional `warnings` field — agents should check it.

Examples:
- All providers: owner='0x...'
- Single provider: owner='0x...', provider='agni'
- Include zero-liquidity NFTs (e.g. burned positions): include_empty=true

owner.description: Wallet address to query for V3 positions.

provider.description: DEX provider: 'agni' or 'fluxion'. Omit to scan both.

include_empty.description: When true, include positions with zero liquidity AND zero uncollected fees. Default false.

tools.name: mantle_suggestTickRange
tools.description:
Suggest tick ranges for a V3 LP position on Mantle (Agni or Fluxion). Reads current pool state and generates three strategies (wide/moderate/tight) with tick bounds snapped to the pool's tick spacing grid and corresponding prices.

Accepts the same inputs as mantle_getV3PoolState: pool_address OR (token_a + token_b + fee_tier + provider).

Examples:
- By address: pool_address='<pool_address>'
- By pair: token_a='WMNT', token_b='USDC', fee_tier=3000, provider='agni'

pool_address.description: V3 pool contract address. If provided, token_a/token_b/fee_tier/provider are optional.

token_a.description: First token symbol or address. Required if pool_address is not given.

token_b.description: Second token symbol or address. Required if pool_address is not given.

fee_tier.description: V3 fee tier (500, 3000, 10000). Required if pool_address is not given.

provider.description: DEX provider: 'agni' or 'fluxion'. Required if pool_address is not given.

tools.name: mantle_analyzePool
tools.description:
[ANALYZE] Deep analysis of a V3 pool on Mantle (Agni or Fluxion). Returns:
- Fee APR based on 24h volume / TVL
- Multi-range APR comparison (10 brackets from ±1% to ±50%)
- Risk assessment (TVL risk, volatility risk, concentration risk)
- Investment return projections (daily/weekly/monthly fees for a given USD amount)
- Recommended range based on recent volatility

Accepts the same inputs as mantle_getV3PoolState: pool_address OR (token_a + token_b + fee_tier + provider).
Optionally pass investment_usd (default: 1000) to see projected returns.

Examples:
- Analyze WMNT/USDC on Agni: token_a='WMNT', token_b='USDC', fee_tier=3000, provider='agni'
- With investment amount: pool_address='<pool_address>', investment_usd=5000

pool_address.description: V3 pool contract address. If provided, token_a/token_b/fee_tier/provider are optional.

token_a.description: First token symbol or address. Required if pool_address is not given.

token_b.description: Second token symbol or address. Required if pool_address is not given.

fee_tier.description: V3 fee tier (500, 3000, 10000). Required if pool_address is not given.

provider.description: DEX provider: 'agni' or 'fluxion'. Required if pool_address is not given.

investment_usd.description: USD amount to project returns for (default: 1000). Used to calculate daily/weekly/monthly fee income.

tools.name: mantle_findPools
tools.description:
Discover all available liquidity pools for a token pair across ALL Mantle DEXes (Agni, Fluxion, Merchant Moe) by querying factory contracts on-chain. Returns every pool with its fee tier/bin step, whether it has liquidity, and DexScreener market data (TVL, 24h volume, fee APR).

POOL RECOMMENDATION: Returns a `recommended_pool` field — the pool with the highest composite score (TVL × 0.6 + volume × 0.4). Always prefer the recommended pool when adding LP unless the user has a specific preference.

This is the authoritative pool discovery tool — it queries factory contracts directly, not external indexers. Use it BEFORE adding LP to find the best pool.

Scans:
- Agni & Fluxion: fee tiers 100 (0.01%), 500 (0.05%), 3000 (0.3%), 10000 (1%)
- Merchant Moe: bin steps 1, 2, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 50, 75, 100

Pool output fields:
- tvl_usd: Total Value Locked in USD (from DexScreener)
- volume_24h_usd: 24-hour trading volume in USD
- fee_apr_pct: Estimated fee APR based on volume/TVL

Examples:
- Find USDC/USDe pools: token_a='USDC', token_b='USDe'
- Find WMNT/USDC pools: token_a='WMNT', token_b='USDC'

tools.name: mantle_getLBPositions
tools.description:
Scan a wallet's Merchant Moe Liquidity Book LP positions on Mantle. Checks all known LB pairs and reads bin balances around the active bin (+-25 bins) to find user-held liquidity.

COVERAGE NOTE: This is a heuristic scan around the current active price, not a full enumeration. Positions minted in bins far from the active price (more than 25 bins away) will not be detected. Coverage is limited to known pairs in the registry.

Returns per-pair breakdown with bin IDs, user share percentage, and estimated token amounts (tokenX/tokenY) based on pro-rata share of bin reserves.

FIELD USAGE for LP removal:
- balance_raw: the ERC-1155 LP share token count from balanceOf(). USE THIS as 'amounts' in mantle_buildRemoveLiquidity.
- user_amount_x_raw / user_amount_y_raw: estimated underlying token amounts (pro-rata of reserves). For DISPLAY/VALUATION only — do NOT pass these as 'amounts' to removeLiquidity.
- RECOMMENDED: use percentage mode in mantle_buildRemoveLiquidity instead of manually extracting balance_raw values.

Use this tool for:
- Approximate portfolio valuation of Merchant Moe LB LP positions
- Understanding near-price liquidity distribution
- Pre-removal checks (which nearby bins hold your liquidity)

Examples:
- All LB positions: owner='<wallet_address>'
- Specific network: owner='<wallet_address>', network='mainnet'

owner.description: Wallet address to enumerate LB positions for.

tools.name: mantle_getAavePositions
tools.description:
Read a wallet's Aave V3 positions on Mantle: supplied collateral, borrowed debt (both variable and stable), health factor, liquidation threshold, and per-reserve aToken/debtToken balances.

Returns aggregate account data (total collateral/debt in USD, health factor with status classification) plus per-reserve breakdowns for all reserves with non-zero supply or debt. Reads stableDebtToken addresses dynamically from on-chain data.

Uses multicall to batch all balance reads into minimal RPC round-trips.

Use this tool for:
- Portfolio valuation (aToken balances are positive assets, debtTokens are liabilities)
- Liquidation risk assessment (health_factor < 1 = liquidatable)
- Pre-transaction safety checks (available borrows, current LTV)

Examples:
- All positions: user='<wallet_address>'
- Specific network: user='<wallet_address>', network='mainnet'

user.description: Wallet address to query Aave V3 positions for.

tools.name: mantle_buildApprove
tools.description:
Build an unsigned ERC-20 approve transaction. Validates spender is whitelisted. IMPORTANT: Pass 'owner' (the wallet address) to auto-check existing allowance — if already sufficient, returns intent='approve_skip' and you should NOT sign/broadcast.

Examples:
- Approve WMNT for Agni SwapRouter: token='WMNT', spender='0x319B69888b0d11cEC22caA5034e25FfFBDc88421', amount='100', owner='0xYourWallet'
- Unlimited approve USDC for Aave Pool: token='USDC', spender='0x458F293454fE0d67EC0655f3672301301DD51422', amount='max', owner='0xYourWallet'

spender.description: Address of the contract to approve (must be on the whitelist).

amount.description: Decimal amount to approve (e.g. '100'). Use 'max' for unlimited.

owner.description: Wallet address that owns the tokens. Used to check existing allowance and skip if sufficient.

nonce.description: Optional nonce override. Query mantle_getNonce first to get the correct value. Only use when the signer has nonce issues.

tools.name: mantle_buildWrapMnt
tools.description:
Build an unsigned transaction to wrap MNT into WMNT. Returns calldata with value field set to the wrap amount.

Examples:
- Wrap 10 MNT: amount='10', sender='0x<signing_wallet>'
- Wrap 0.5 MNT: amount='0.5'

amount.description: Decimal amount of MNT to wrap (e.g. '10').

sender.description: Signing wallet address. Scopes idempotency_key to this wallet.

request_id.description: Unique ID for this user intent.

nonce.description: Optional nonce override. Query mantle_getNonce first to get the correct value. Only use when the signer has nonce issues.

tools.name: mantle_buildUnwrapMnt
tools.description:
Build an unsigned transaction to unwrap WMNT back to MNT.

Examples:
- Unwrap 10 WMNT: amount='10', sender='0x<signing_wallet>'
- Unwrap 0.5 WMNT: amount='0.5'

amount.description: Decimal amount of WMNT to unwrap (e.g. '10').

sender.description: Signing wallet address. Scopes idempotency_key to this wallet.

request_id.description: Unique ID for this user intent.

nonce.description: Optional nonce override. Query mantle_getNonce first to get the correct value. Only use when the signer has nonce issues.

tools.name: mantle_buildSwap
tools.description:
Build an unsigned swap transaction on a whitelisted DEX. Pool parameters (bin_step, fee_tier) are auto-discovered on-chain for the best liquidity pool.

WORKFLOW:
1. Call mantle_getSwapQuote → returns router_address, provider, and resolved_pool_params
2. Call mantle_buildApprove: token=token_in, spender=router_address from step 1, amount=amount_in, owner=wallet_address. IMPORTANT: spender is the ROUTER address (e.g. 0x319B69… for Agni), NOT the token address.
3. Sign and broadcast the approve unsigned_tx. Wait for confirmation.
4. Call mantle_buildSwap with: provider from quote, amount_out_min from quote's minimum_out_raw, owner=wallet_address (triggers blocking allowance check), and quote_fee_tier/quote_provider for cross-validation
5. Sign and broadcast the swap unsigned_tx

If owner is passed and allowance is insufficient, buildSwap will REJECT with INSUFFICIENT_ALLOWANCE (not just warn). The error includes the correct router_address to approve.

The response includes pool_params.router_address — this is the spender for approve.

Examples:
- Swap 100 USDC for USDT0 on Merchant Moe: provider='merchant_moe', token_in='USDC', token_out='USDT0', amount_in='100', recipient='0x...', owner='0x...'
- Swap 10 WMNT for USDC on Agni: provider='agni', token_in='WMNT', token_out='USDC', amount_in='10', recipient='0x...', owner='0x...'

amount_in.description: Decimal amount of token_in to swap (e.g. '10').

amount_out_min.description: REQUIRED: Minimum output in raw units (from mantle_getSwapQuote minimum_out_raw). Protects against slippage and sandwich attacks.

allow_zero_min.description: Set to true to allow zero amount_out_min (DANGEROUS — no slippage protection). Only use for testing.

fee_tier.description: V3 fee tier (100=0.01%, 500=0.05%, 2500=0.25%, 3000=0.3%, 10000=1%). Auto-resolved from on-chain liquidity for agni/fluxion when omitted.

bin_step.description: LB bin step (1=stablecoins, 2=LSTs, 25=volatile). Auto-resolved from known pairs for merchant_moe.

quote_provider.description: Provider from a prior getSwapQuote call. Used to cross-validate consistency — emits a warning if build resolves a different provider.

quote_fee_tier.description: Fee tier from a prior getSwapQuote resolved_pool_params. Used to cross-validate — emits a warning if build resolves a different fee tier.

quote_bin_step.description: Bin step from a prior getSwapQuote resolved_pool_params. Used to cross-validate — emits a warning if build resolves a different bin step.

owner.description: STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Wallet address that owns the input tokens (the signer). Triggers a blocking allowance check — if allowance is insufficient, the call rejects with INSUFFICIENT_ALLOWANCE (includes the correct router_address to approve) instead of returning a swap tx that would revert on-chain.

nonce.description: Optional nonce override. Query mantle_getNonce first to get the correct value. Only use when the signer has nonce issues.

tools.name: mantle_buildAddLiquidity
tools.description:
Build an unsigned add-liquidity transaction. For V3 DEXes (agni/fluxion) mints an NFT position. For Merchant Moe LB adds to bin-based pools.

Amount modes:
- Token amounts: provide amount_a and amount_b directly
- USD amount: provide amount_usd to auto-split between tokens (fetches live prices; V3 uses pool-state-aware ratio)

Range presets (RECOMMENDED for simplicity):
- 'aggressive' — ±5% around current price (highest capital efficiency, needs frequent rebalancing)
- 'moderate' — ±10% around current price (balanced efficiency vs. rebalancing)
- 'conservative' — ±20% around current price (wider range, less rebalancing needed)
For V3: auto-computes tick_lower/tick_upper from current pool tick. For Merchant Moe LB: auto-computes bin spread.
Explicit tick_lower/tick_upper override range_preset.

IMPORTANT: Pass 'owner' to enable a blocking allowance check. If either token's allowance is insufficient, the call rejects with INSUFFICIENT_ALLOWANCE and includes the correct spender address and a ready-to-use mantle_buildApprove invocation. The response always includes pool_params.router_address — the spender to approve.

WORKFLOW: Before calling this tool, use mantle_findPools to discover the best pool (recommended_pool) for the token pair.

Examples:
- With range preset: provider='agni', token_a='WMNT', token_b='USDC', amount_usd=1000, range_preset='moderate', recipient='0x...', owner='0x...'
- Token mode: provider='agni', token_a='WMNT', token_b='USDC', amount_a='10', amount_b='8', recipient='0x...', owner='0x...'
- USD mode: provider='agni', token_a='WMNT', token_b='USDC', amount_usd=1000, recipient='0x...', owner='0x...'

amount_a.description: Decimal amount of token_a. Required unless amount_usd is provided.

amount_b.description: Decimal amount of token_b. Required unless amount_usd is provided.

amount_usd.description: USD amount to invest (auto-splits 50/50 between tokens using live prices). Alternative to amount_a + amount_b. Example: 1000 for $1000.

fee_tier.description: V3 fee tier for agni/fluxion: 100=0.01% (stablecoins, e.g. USDe/USDT), 500=0.05%, 2500=0.25% (e.g. WMNT/USDe, cmETH/USDe on Agni), 3000=0.3%, 10000=1%. Default: 3000 — but you MUST pass the actual pool's fee tier (use mantle_findPools to look it up); defaulting to 3000 will fail for pools that don't exist at that tier.

tick_lower.description: Lower tick bound. For agni/fluxion. Overrides range_preset. Default: full range.

tick_upper.description: Upper tick bound. For agni/fluxion. Overrides range_preset. Default: full range.

range_preset.description: RECOMMENDED: Price range preset for LP position. 'aggressive' (±5%), 'moderate' (±10%), 'conservative' (±20%). Auto-computes tick bounds (V3) or bin spread (Merchant Moe LB) from current pool price. Overridden by explicit tick_lower/tick_upper. If omitted and no ticks provided, defaults to full range (V3) or ±3 bins (LB).

active_id.description: Active bin ID override. For merchant_moe. If omitted, auto-resolved from on-chain pair state (recommended).

id_slippage.description: Bin ID slippage tolerance. For merchant_moe.

delta_ids.description: Relative bin IDs for distribution. For merchant_moe.

distribution_x.description: Token X distribution per bin (1e18 = 100%). For merchant_moe.

distribution_y.description: Token Y distribution per bin (1e18 = 100%). For merchant_moe.

owner.description: STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Wallet address that will sign the transaction. Triggers a blocking allowance check for both tokens — if either allowance is insufficient, the call rejects with INSUFFICIENT_ALLOWANCE (includes the correct spender address to approve) instead of returning a tx that would revert on-chain with STF.

nonce.description: Optional nonce override. Query mantle_getNonce first to get the correct value. Only use when the signer has nonce issues.

tools.name: mantle_buildRemoveLiquidity
tools.description:
Build an unsigned remove-liquidity transaction. For V3 DEXes uses decreaseLiquidity+collect via multicall. For Merchant Moe LB removes from specified bins.

V3 amount modes:
- Exact liquidity: provide 'liquidity' as a raw amount
- Percentage: provide 'percentage' (1-100) to remove a portion of the position (reads current liquidity on-chain)

Merchant Moe amount modes:
- Percentage (RECOMMENDED): provide 'percentage' (1-100) to auto-read LP balances on-chain and remove proportionally. Optionally provide 'ids' to target specific bins; if omitted, scans ±25 bins around active price.
- Explicit: provide 'ids' (bin IDs) and 'amounts' (LP token balances to burn). CRITICAL: 'amounts' must be 'balance_raw' values from mantle_getLBPositions output — NOT 'user_amount_x_raw' or 'user_amount_y_raw'. LP token balances are typically 1e18-scale numbers.

Examples:
- Remove 50% of V3 position: provider='agni', token_id='12345', percentage=50, recipient='0x...'
- Remove all V3 position: provider='agni', token_id='12345', percentage=100, recipient='0x...'
- Remove exact liquidity: provider='agni', token_id='12345', liquidity='1000000', recipient='0x...'
- Remove all Merchant Moe LP (recommended): provider='merchant_moe', token_a='WMNT', token_b='USDC', bin_step=25, percentage=100, recipient='0x...'
- Remove 50% of Merchant Moe LP: provider='merchant_moe', token_a='WMNT', token_b='USDC', bin_step=25, percentage=50, recipient='0x...'
- Remove specific LB bins: provider='merchant_moe', token_a='WMNT', token_b='USDC', bin_step=25, ids=[8388608], amounts=['500000000000000000'], recipient='0x...'

token_id.description: V3 NFT position token ID. For agni/fluxion.

liquidity.description: Exact amount of liquidity to remove. For agni/fluxion. Use 'percentage' for proportional removal.

percentage.description: Percentage of position liquidity to remove (1-100). Works for BOTH V3 (agni/fluxion) and Merchant Moe. Reads current LP balances on-chain and calculates the amount. RECOMMENDED for Merchant Moe — avoids the need to manually query balance_raw values. Example: 50 removes half, 100 removes all.

token_a.description: First token symbol or address. For merchant_moe. Token order does not matter — canonical order is resolved on-chain.

token_b.description: Second token symbol or address. For merchant_moe. Token order does not matter — canonical order is resolved on-chain.

ids.description: Bin IDs to remove from. For merchant_moe. Optional when using percentage mode (auto-scans ±25 bins if omitted).

amounts.description: LP token balances to burn per bin. For merchant_moe. MUST be 'balance_raw' values from mantle_getLBPositions — these are ERC-1155 LP share token counts (typically 1e18-scale). Do NOT pass 'user_amount_x_raw' or 'user_amount_y_raw' (those are underlying token estimates, not LP shares). Prefer using 'percentage' mode instead.

owner.description: Wallet address that holds the LP tokens (the signer). For merchant_moe percentage mode: used to query on-chain LP balances. If omitted, defaults to recipient. Provide this when recipient differs from the signer.

nonce.description: Optional nonce override. Query mantle_getNonce first to get the correct value. Only use when the signer has nonce issues.

tools.name: mantle_buildSetLBApprovalForAll
tools.description:
Build an unsigned `approveForAll` transaction on a Merchant Moe LB Pair (ERC-1155-style share approval). This is REQUIRED before `mantle_buildRemoveLiquidity` can succeed for merchant_moe: the router burns the user's LB shares via `LBPair.burn(user, ...)`, which requires `isApprovedForAll(user, router) == true`. Pair can be specified directly via 'pair', or resolved from 'token_a' + 'token_b' + 'bin_step' via the LB Factory. Pass 'owner' to auto-skip when the operator is already in the desired state (intent='approve_skip').

Examples:
- Approve LB Router to burn WMNT/USDT shares: token_a='WMNT', token_b='USDT', bin_step=15, operator='0x013e138EF6008ae5FDFDE29700e3f2Bc61d21E3a', owner='0xYourWallet'
- Revoke: approved=false

pair.description: LB Pair contract address. If omitted, resolved from token_a/token_b/bin_step.

token_a.description: First token symbol or address (alternative to 'pair').

token_b.description: Second token symbol or address (alternative to 'pair').

bin_step.description: LB pair bin step (alternative to 'pair'). E.g. 15, 25.

operator.description: Address to approve/revoke (must be a whitelisted contract, typically the LB Router).

approved.description: true to grant approval, false to revoke. Defaults to true.

owner.description: Wallet address that owns the LB shares. Used to pre-check isApprovedForAll and skip when the desired state is already set.

tools.name: mantle_buildAaveSupply
tools.description:
Build an unsigned Aave V3 supply (deposit) transaction. This calls Pool.supply() which pulls tokens via transferFrom AND mints aTokens — the aToken balance is the ONLY on-chain record redeemable via withdraw. NEVER model 'supply' as a plain ERC-20 transfer() to the Pool address (0x458F293454fE0d67EC0655f3672301301DD51422) — that bypasses Pool accounting, mints NO aToken, and locks funds PERMANENTLY with no recovery path. Always use THIS tool for Aave supply operations. Remember to approve the asset for the Pool contract first.

IMPORTANT: Only USDT0 is supported on Aave V3 — NOT USDT. If the user holds USDT, swap USDT → USDT0 on Merchant Moe first.

ISOLATION MODE: WETH and WMNT are Isolation Mode assets. Supplying them as your ONLY collateral restricts borrows to: USDC, USDT0, USDe, GHO. Other assets CANNOT be borrowed in Isolation Mode.

Examples:
- Supply 100 USDC: asset='USDC', amount='100', on_behalf_of='0x...'
- Supply 10 WMNT: asset='WMNT', amount='10', on_behalf_of='0x...'

asset.description: Token symbol or address to supply.

on_behalf_of.description: Address that will receive the aTokens (typically the sender).

nonce.description: Optional nonce override. Query mantle_getNonce first to get the correct value. Only use when the signer has nonce issues.

tools.name: mantle_buildAaveBorrow
tools.description:
Build an unsigned Aave V3 borrow transaction. Requires sufficient collateral deposited first.

IMPORTANT: Only USDT0 is supported on Aave V3 — NOT USDT. If the user wants to borrow Tether, use asset='USDT0'.

ISOLATION MODE: If the borrower's only collateral is an Isolation Mode asset (WETH, WMNT), they can ONLY borrow assets flagged as borrowableInIsolation: USDC, USDT0, USDe, GHO. Attempting to borrow other assets (sUSDe, FBTC, syrupUSDT, wrsETH, WETH, WMNT) will REVERT.

Examples:
- Borrow 50 USDC at variable rate: asset='USDC', amount='50', on_behalf_of='0x...'
- Borrow 10 WMNT at variable rate: asset='WMNT', amount='10', on_behalf_of='0x...'

asset.description: Token symbol or address to borrow.

on_behalf_of.description: Address of the borrower (must have collateral).

nonce.description: Optional nonce override. Query mantle_getNonce first to get the correct value. Only use when the signer has nonce issues.

tools.name: mantle_buildAaveRepay
tools.description:
Build an unsigned Aave V3 repay transaction. Use amount='max' to repay the full debt. Remember to approve the asset for the Pool first.

Examples:
- Repay 50 USDC: asset='USDC', amount='50', on_behalf_of='0x...'
- Repay full WMNT debt: asset='WMNT', amount='max', on_behalf_of='0x...'

asset.description: Token symbol or address to repay.

amount.description: Decimal amount to repay, or 'max' for full debt.

on_behalf_of.description: Address of the borrower whose debt to repay.

nonce.description: Optional nonce override. Query mantle_getNonce first to get the correct value. Only use when the signer has nonce issues.

tools.name: mantle_buildAaveWithdraw
tools.description:
Build an unsigned Aave V3 withdraw transaction. Use amount='max' to withdraw entire balance. May lower health factor.

Examples:
- Withdraw 50 USDC: asset='USDC', amount='50', to='0x...', owner='0x...'
- Withdraw all WMNT: asset='WMNT', amount='max', to='0x...', owner='0x...'

asset.description: Token symbol or address to withdraw.

amount.description: Decimal amount to withdraw, or 'max' for full balance.

to.description: Address to receive the withdrawn tokens.

owner.description: Signing wallet address (the supplier whose aTokens are being burned). REQUIRED: used to pin gas/fee/nonce deterministically. May differ from `to` when routing withdrawn funds to another address.

nonce.description: Optional nonce override. Query mantle_getNonce first to get the correct value. Only use when the signer has nonce issues.

tools.name: mantle_buildAaveSetCollateral
tools.description:
Build an unsigned Aave V3 transaction to enable or disable a supplied asset as collateral.

MSG.SENDER: This transaction operates on the SIGNING WALLET (msg.sender), not an arbitrary address. The user param is only used for preflight diagnostics.

DIAGNOSTICS: When user is provided, runs on-chain checks before building the tx:
- Verifies aToken balance > 0 (user has actually supplied)
- Checks reserve config (LTV > 0, active, not frozen)
- Reads user config bitmap to detect if collateral is already enabled/disabled
- Returns a diagnostics object with the findings

If getUserAccountData shows totalCollateralBase=0 after a successful supply, possible causes (checked in order):
1. Collateral flag not enabled → this tool fixes it
2. Reserve LTV=0 on-chain → tool will error with LTV_IS_ZERO
3. Oracle price=0 → collateral enabled but USD value is 0
4. Reserve not active → tool will error with RESERVE_NOT_ACTIVE

Examples:
- Enable WMNT as collateral: asset='WMNT', owner='0x...'
- Disable USDC as collateral: asset='USDC', owner='0x...', use_as_collateral=false

asset.description: Token symbol or address to enable/disable as collateral.

owner.description: Signing wallet address. REQUIRED: used to pin gas/fee/nonce and to drive preflight diagnostics (aToken balance, collateral status, reserve config). The tx always operates on msg.sender on-chain; this field is NOT encoded into calldata, but it must match the signing wallet or the collateral toggle will apply to the wrong account.

user.description: DEPRECATED alias for `owner`. Prefer `owner` — kept only for backward compatibility; will be removed in a future release.

use_as_collateral.description: true to enable as collateral (default), false to disable.

nonce.description: Optional nonce override. Query mantle_getNonce first to get the correct value. Only use when the signer has nonce issues.

tools.name: mantle_getSwapPairs
tools.description:
List known trading pairs and their pool parameters for a DEX. Returns bin_step (Merchant Moe) or fee_tier (Agni/Fluxion) for each pair. Call this BEFORE mantle_buildSwap to get the correct pool parameters.

Examples:
- All Merchant Moe pairs: provider='merchant_moe'
- All Agni pairs: provider='agni'
- All pairs across all DEXes: (no provider)

provider.description: Filter by DEX: 'agni', 'fluxion', or 'merchant_moe'. Omit for all DEXes.

tools.name: mantle_buildCollectFees
tools.description:
Build an unsigned transaction to collect accrued fees from a V3 LP position (Agni or Fluxion). Collects the maximum available fees for both tokens.

WORKFLOW:
1. Obtain the V3 NFT position token_id — call mantle_getV3Positions to enumerate, look it up on a block explorer (Mantlescan) / https://agni.finance, or read it from the unsigned_tx response of a prior mantle_buildAddLiquidity call.
2. Call mantle_buildCollectFees with the token_id, recipient, and owner
3. Sign and broadcast the unsigned_tx

Examples:
- Collect Agni fees: provider='agni', token_id='12345', recipient='0x...', owner='0x...'
- Collect Fluxion fees: provider='fluxion', token_id='67890', recipient='0x...', owner='0x...'

NOTE: Merchant Moe LB fees are embedded in bin reserves and collected automatically when removing liquidity via mantle_buildRemoveLiquidity. This tool only supports V3 positions (Agni/Fluxion).

recipient.description: Address to receive the collected fees.

owner.description: Signing wallet address — the NFT position owner. REQUIRED: used to pin gas/fee/nonce deterministically. On-chain the collect() call is authorized via ownerOf(tokenId) == msg.sender, so this field MUST equal the signing wallet.

nonce.description: Optional nonce override. Query mantle_getNonce first to get the correct value. Only use when the signer has nonce issues.

tools.name: mantle_parseUnits
tools.description:
Convert a human-readable decimal amount to its raw integer representation (wei/smallest unit). Use this instead of manually computing amount * 10**decimals.

Examples:
- 100 USDC (6 decimals): amount='100', decimals=6 → '100000000'
- 1.5 ETH (18 decimals): amount='1.5', decimals=18 → '1500000000000000000'
- 0.001 WBTC (8 decimals): amount='0.001', decimals=8 → '100000'

tools.name: mantle_formatUnits
tools.description:
Convert a raw integer amount (wei/smallest unit) to its human-readable decimal representation. Use this instead of manually computing amount / 10**decimals.

Examples:
- 100000000 with 6 decimals → '100.0' (USDC)
- 1500000000000000000 with 18 decimals → '1.5' (ETH)

tools.name: mantle_encodeCall
tools.description:
ABI-encode a smart contract function call. Returns encoded calldata (hex). Use this ONLY when no dedicated CLI command exists for the operation. For standard operations (swaps, LP, Aave), ALWAYS use the dedicated CLI commands instead.

⛔ SAFETY: This tool BLOCKS ERC-20 transfer()/transferFrom() calls whose recipient is a whitelisted protocol contract (Aave Pool, DEX routers, position managers). Sending tokens directly to these contracts locks funds permanently. Use the dedicated CLI verb instead (aave supply, swap build-swap, lp add).

Accepts ABI as either:
- JSON array: '[{"type":"function","name":"approve",...}]'
- Human-readable: 'function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) returns (bool)'

If 'to' address is also provided, returns a ready-to-use unsigned_tx object.

Examples:
- Custom contract: abi='function claim(uint256 id)', function_name='claim', args=[42], to='<contract_address>'

abi.description: ABI as JSON array or human-readable signature (e.g. 'function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) returns (bool)').

function_name.description: Name of the function to call (e.g. 'transfer', 'claim').

args.description: Function arguments as an array. Types are inferred from the ABI. Use strings for addresses and large integers (uint256).

to.description: Target contract address. If provided, the response includes a ready-to-use unsigned_tx.

value.description: Hex-encoded MNT value to send with the call (default: zero).

tools.name: mantle_buildRawTx
tools.description:
Build an unsigned_tx from raw calldata. Use this as the FINAL STEP when constructing transactions for protocols not covered by dedicated CLI commands.

⛔ SAFETY: This tool BLOCKS ERC-20 transfer()/transferFrom() calls whose recipient is a whitelisted protocol contract (Aave Pool, DEX routers, position managers). Sending tokens directly to these contracts locks funds permanently. Use the dedicated CLI verb instead (aave supply, swap build-swap, lp add).

Typical workflow for unsupported operations:
1. mantle-cli utils parse-units — convert decimal amounts to raw integers
2. mantle-cli utils encode-call — ABI-encode the function call → get hex calldata
3. mantle-cli utils build-tx — wrap the calldata into a signed-ready unsigned_tx

This tool validates the target address and hex format, converts decimal MNT values to hex wei, and returns a properly formatted unsigned_tx with warning labels.

Examples:
- Call a contract: to='<contract>', data='<hex_from_encode_call>'
- Call with MNT: to='<contract>', data='<hex>', value='0.5' (decimal MNT)

data.description: Hex-encoded calldata (from encode-call output). Use '0x' for plain MNT transfers.

value.description: MNT to send: decimal (e.g. '0.5', '10') or hex wei (e.g. '0x0'). Default: '0x0' (no MNT).

description.description: Human-readable description of what this transaction does (shown in human_summary).

request_id.description: Unique ID for this user intent.

nonce.description: Optional nonce override. Query mantle_getNonce first to get the correct value. Only use when the signer has nonce issues.
